title: Norwegian Redcurrant Toast
description: A simple Scandinavian-inspired dessert featuring fresh Norwegian redcurrants atop toasted bread.

ingredients.name: Toast
ingredients.notes: old-fashioned Norwegian bread, toasted until lightly browned

ingredients.name: Granulated sugar
ingredients.notes: optional, but recommended to balance tartness

instructions: Toast the old-fashioned Norwegian bread until lightly browned.
Rinse the redcurrants and remove any stems or leaves.
Arrange the toasted bread slices on a baking sheet.
Top each bread slice with a layer of redcurrants.
Sprinkle granulated sugar over the redcurrants, if using.
Bake for 5-7 minutes until the redcurrants have softened slightly.
Serve warm, garnished with additional redcurrants if desired.
